right now there are a bunch of papers and books

### Alternatives considered

_No response_

_No response_

comments.body: also the research paper needs to be FULLY COMPREHENSIVE and must be based on THE ENTIRE DEV CYCLE of the ENTIRE PROJECT and the data that we collected IN FULL. the includes the research based claim that we confirmed that software engineering as a discipline is entirely commodity work aside from governance which is always scarcity based and never commodity, it's only actual pain point is the people

## Triage — 2026-09-17 (`develop` @ f2467910, v0.8.0)

**Status: NOT STARTED** · size **XL** · confidence high

**The ask, as read:** Collapse the repository's many papers and books down to exactly one book.pdf and one paper.pdf, and make that single research paper fully comprehensive over the entire dev cycle and all collected data, including the confirmed claim that software engineering production is commodity work while governance is the only scarcity (the people being the real pain point).

### What already ships
- Exactly one book.pdf, one book.epub, one book-print.html and one paper.pdf are produced and published per documentation channel (release-surfaces.yml:417, :446) — the published artifact set is already singular per channel, and was before the issue was filed (ADR-0032 / PR #147)
- PR #168 (a4ccd753) removed the two tracked, stale copies of the rendered documentation site — the one duplicate-of-the-docs that was actually deleted under this issue's number
- The commodity/governance-scarcity thesis the issue comment demands exists as finished prose with measurements (src/vibey_tools/gh/docs/paper.md:156–211): a statement, a ±18% tolerance window over 61 generations, the waste(n) coordination model, and an honest scope paragraph

### Evidence in the tree
- docs/paper.md:212 — the root paper calls vibey-gh's paper "the companion paper of `vibey-gh`, in this repository at `src/vibey_tools/gh/docs/paper.md`": multiple papers are the documented, intended state today
- docs/paper.md:233 — the same companion paper is cited as a reference entry, so the plural is baked into the bibliography too
- src/vibey_tools/gh/docs/paper.md:1 — a second, 302-line journal paper ("Exact-Head Evaluation…") lives in the tree
- src/vibey_runners/agy/docs/paper.md:1, src/vibey_runners/claude/docs/paper.md:1, src/vibey_runners/codex/docs/paper.md:1, src/vibey_runners/cursor/docs/paper.md:1, src/vibey_runners/qwen/docs/paper.md:1, src/vibey_tools/bootstrap/docs/paper.md:1, src/vibey_tools/skills/docs/paper.md:1 — seven more distinct research papers, one per tenant; nine paper.md sources in total
- properdocs.yml:44 through properdocs.yml:87 — the one nav that becomes the one book covers only root docs (home, 2 guides, 2 reference, 36 ADRs, paper.md); no tenant documentation is in it, so the single book is not "everything"
- src/vibey_runners/claude/properdocs.yml, src/vibey_tools/gh/properdocs.yml (+6 more) — eight further site configs, i.e. eight further book definitions, that no workflow builds
- …and 7 more

### What is actually left
- Decide and record (ADR) what happens to the eight tenant papers: merged into one paper as sections/appendices, deleted, or demoted to non-paper design notes. Nothing can proceed until this is chosen.
- Merge the surviving content into a single docs/paper.md and delete docs/paper.md:212 and :233's 'companion paper' framing plus its reference entry.
- Lift the commodity thesis (src/vibey_tools/gh/docs/paper.md:156–211) and the six-materials calculus (:212–267) into the single published paper, since they are the claim the issue comment names and today they never reach paper.pdf.
- Define and gather 'the data we collected IN FULL': there is no named dataset in the tree — decide the source (ledger events, PR/issue history, CI timings) and write an extraction script so the numbers in the paper are reproducible rather than recalled.
- Rewrite the paper's Validation section to cover the entire dev cycle (currently three validation levels and a two-engine runbook, docs/paper.md:188).
- Delete or repurpose the eight unused tenant properdocs.yml files, and decide whether tenant documentation joins the root nav (which is what would make the one book cover 'everything').
- If tenant docs join the nav, re-check the book pipeline: chapter titles must carry no colon (ADR-0032) and the page count jump changes the KDP margin tier (see #162).
- Delete or fold in the 8 tenant `docs/paper.md` files (src/vibey_runners/{agy,claude,codex,cursor,qwen}/docs/paper.md, src/vibey_tools/{bootstrap,gh,skills}/docs/paper.md) — nine papers remain tracked
- …and 6 more

### Blockers
- Operator decision required on the fate of the eight tenant papers — they are per-package journal papers with distinct theses, not drafts, so merging is a content judgement no developer can make alone.
- 'the data we collected IN FULL' names no artifact that exists in the repository; the dataset must be defined before a comprehensive paper can be written.
- ADR-0032 (docs/architecture/decisions/0032-…md) explicitly designs for one paper per repository plus companions; consolidating contradicts it, so ADR-0032 needs superseding or amending first.

> ⚠️ **Verdict corrected by the verifier.** Neither half of the ask was done, and every item the auditor credits as shipped predates the issue or is not a book/paper.

HALF 1 — collapse to one book.pdf and one paper.pdf. The tree today still holds 9 tracked `docs/paper.md` sources (`git ls-files '*docs/paper.md'` = 9: docs/paper.md plus agy, claude, codex, cursor, qwen, bootstrap, gh, skills), 9 tracked `properdocs.yml` book definitions (`git ls-files '*properdocs.yml'` = 9), and 10 tracked `release-surfaces.yml` files (9 real + the vibey-gh template) each of which runs `vibey-gh book` and `vibey-gh paper`. Nothing was consolidated or deleted. The root paper actively DECLARES the plural as intended: docs/paper.md:212 calls the second paper 'the companion paper of `vibey-gh`, in this repository at `src/vibey_tools/gh/docs/paper.md`', and docs/paper.md:233 lists it as a bibliography entry. The published set is not singular either: release-surfaces.yml:77-83 sets channel=develop or channel=main, and :433/:455 copy book.pdf and paper.pdf into that channel's site — two of each are published.

HALF 2 — the paper made fully comprehensive over the whole dev cycle, including the commodity/governance-scarcity thesis. docs/paper.md is 234 lines; grepping it for commodit|scarcit|natural law|constant|velocity|hardware|sleep|network stab|tolerance returns exactly one hit, 'throughput scales as' at :104, which is about FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. Its section list (:27 Introduction, :37, :58, :94, :116, :155, :188 Validation, :203, :215) has no place this was added. Its last commit is 04766b44 (PR #156), committed 2026-09-15 15:44:14 UTC — PR #156 is not credited to #155, and the comment demanding the thesis landed at 16:03 UTC, after it. No paper.md anywhere in the tree has been touched since that commit.

THE CREDITED WORK IS NOT RESPONSIVE. CHANGELOG.md:58 credits exactly one change to #155: a4ccd753 (#168), 'stop tracking the two built documentation sites'. I listed its 200 changed files — every one is rendered HTML under `site/` or `src/vibey_tools/gh/site/`. It deleted zero papers and zero books; it removed build output that `.gitignore:19-20` now covers. The count of papers and books in the tree is identical before and after.

THE THESIS WAS NOT WRITTEN FOR THIS ISSUE. src/vibey_tools/gh/docs/paper.md:156-211 does contain the thesis as the auditor says (verified: the Statement at :160-164, the 1.4±0.25 / ±18% over 61 generations at :169, waste(n), the honest-scope paragraph), but its single commit is ce6c2cce, 2026-09-15 12:01:28 UTC — 2h41m BEFORE the issue was filed (14:42:47Z), as part of the absorb import. It is inherited text, not work on this issue. And it is never published: release-surfaces.yml:446 renders only docs/paper.md (cli.py:1217 defaults `--source docs/paper.md` and the workflow passes no override), and the governance copy at release-surfaces.yml:320-327 deliberately takes only constitution.md, doctrines.md, commandments.md, bill-of-rights.md and sd-*.md out of that tenant.

One correction to the auditor's own evidence: its claim that 'no paper.md in the tree has been touched since 2026-09-15, i.e. nothing after this issue was filed' is imprecise — 04766b44 landed an hour after the issue opened. The substance survives: that commit neither consolidated anything nor added the thesis.

**Notes:** Read the issue two ways and both matter. Read as 'the published files', it is close to done: main/ already serves exactly one paper.pdf and one book.pdf. Read as the user plainly wrote it — 'there are a bunch of papers and books' — it is barely started: nine paper.md sources and nine properdocs.yml still sit in the tree, and the root paper itself advertises a companion. The single credited commit (#168) deleted duplicate rendered sites, not duplicate papers. The comment's substantive demand (a comprehensive paper carrying the commodity/governance claim) is the larger half and is untouched in the published paper, even though the prose for it already exists one directory away.


<sub>Automated triage pass: every open issue re-read against the tree at `develop@f2467910`, each verdict then attacked by an independent verifier whose job was to refute it. Supersedes the 2026-09-15 triage, which was measured at 0.7.0.</sub>
The following PRs have been merged into develop and may address this issue: #277, #168

## Audit status — 2026-09-19

**Status: PARTIAL · planning size: XL**

The root documentation now presents a consolidated family paper and exposes PDF/DOCX artifacts, but nine tenant `docs/paper.md` sources still coexist with the root source. The acceptance request for a fully comprehensive single book/paper, incorporating the full development-cycle evidence and thesis consistently, is therefore not yet proven complete.

Audited at develop/main `130afa0449fdcc65833f54ede596f0b4e45a145e`; this issue remains open. This comment supersedes older automated status notes.
